headlines.description: Anthony Gordon and Harry Kane secured England a straightforward 2-0 win away to 10-man Czechia at the end of one of the most dramatic days in the nation's footballing history.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gordon, Kane lead England past 10-man Czechia

headlines.description: New Scotland boss Sebastien Pocognoli endured a demoralising Hampden debut as his 10-man side were dismantled 3-0 by sure-footed Switzerland in the Nations League.
headlines.shortLinkText: Scotland routed by Swiss in Pocognoli's home debut

headlines.description: Lamine Yamal fired a double as Spain cruised to a 4-1 win against Croatia in Seville on Tuesday to open up a three-point lead at the top of their Nations League group.
headlines.shortLinkText: Spain extend record unbeaten run to 40 with Yamal double

headlines.description: A fired up Brazil have out-gunned the Socceroos 4-2 in a dramatic rematch in which the hosts briefly led thanks to a Connor Metcalfe stunner.
headlines.shortLinkText: Socceroos bring out Brazil's best in fiery rematch

headlines.description: History-making goals from teenagers Mathis Albert and Julian Hall propelled a youthful United States men's national team to a 4-2 win over Chile in Tuesday's friendly in St. Louis.
headlines.shortLinkText: New-look USMNT beats Chile as teens make history
